Strain is a fundamental property of a material defined as the deformation per unit length, so as the object deforms more, the greater the strain of that object's lattice and, effectively, the more energy that lattice stores due to the volume change of the object (strain-energy). As we all know, work performed on a system will always increase the energy of that system, and with the increase in energy of a system, so to does the temperature of that system increase.
